releases.name: Ascend 2026-09-10
releases.body: First release. Ascend is a vertical climbing game with generated platforms, coins, gems, and powerups. It works with touch controls on a phone.

jobs.description: Endless vertical platformer with moving platforms, powerups, and touch controls for phones.

releases.name: Contracts API 2026-09-10
releases.body: Created the contracts backend in six stages. It started with health and draft routes, then added a public record, PIN unlock, and a Redis lockout after bad guesses. Assistant routes, real Polygon notarization, and in-house e-signatures followed. The assistant now gives clear errors, times out, and limits each visitor. Signing no longer mints automatically, and minting is its own step.

jobs.description: Backend for the contract app: drafts, PIN unlock, e-signatures, and Polygon notarization.

releases.name: Bee Sim 2026-09-10
releases.body: First release. Bee Sim shipped as a single static page. The deploy setup was reworked several times until the page loaded from the root of the site.

jobs.description: Browser bee strategy game with generated terrain, zones, and a mosaic mode.

releases.name: Boba Break-Even 2026-09-11
releases.body: First release. Boba Break-Even calculates cups needed to cover costs. A second update on the same day polished the page.

jobs.description: Break-even calculator and seven day shop game for a bubble tea shop.

releases.name: Dronesim 2026-09-11
releases.body: First release. Dronesim is an operator console for drone shows with a timeline, formations, and optional audio.

jobs.description: Pixel art drone show simulator with a timeline editor and image based formations.

releases.name: Threat Atlas 2026-09-11
releases.body: First release. Threat Atlas shows a rotating globe with layered threat data and country intel.

jobs.description: Interactive globe of security threats with layers, filters, and country intel.

releases.name: Atlas of Tiles 2026-09-11
releases.body: First release. Atlas of Tiles lets players rotate tiles to close loops, with several regional tile styles.

jobs.description: Tile rotating puzzle where closed loops score, with regional tile styles.

releases.name: Arcade Backend 2026-09-14
releases.body: Version 2 now locks every on chain write so two scores can never reuse the same number. Each game and each player has a lock, and players wait through a cooldown between submissions. Every submission is logged with its outcome for audit.

releases.name: Arcade Backend 2026-09-11
releases.body: First release. The arcade backend accepts scores for registered games and writes them on chain.

jobs.description: Score server for the arcade games, with locks, cooldowns, and on chain writes.

releases.name: Mohave Browser 2026-09-16
releases.body: First build of the browser. The build setup was trimmed and updated for the newest Gecko engine.

jobs.description: Small Android web browser built on the Gecko engine.

releases.name: QSR Tracker Backend 2026-09-16
releases.body: Added engine routes for a snapshot, a ledger, a heartbeat, and a two way command queue.

releases.name: QSR Tracker Backend 2026-09-03
releases.body: Added a food network news relay and a congressional trading disclosure relay. Fixed a lockfile problem that was blocking the last deploy.

releases.name: QSR Tracker Backend 2026-09-01
releases.body: Added insider filing support to the SEC relay.

releases.name: QSR Tracker Backend 2026-08-30
releases.body: Added a shared quote relay that stretches across visitors. Quote and history requests now batch into one call and warm the whole ticker list on open. Batches cap at the free credit limit and defer the rest.

releases.name: QSR Tracker Backend 2026-08-29
releases.body: Created the backend. It started with SEC filings, economic data, tariffs, and magazine news. Added device sync and a scheduled refresh. Fixed filing numbers, feed titles, and filing links. Added futures prices for commodities with a real exchange contract.

jobs.description: Data relay for the restaurant industry tracker: filings, news, quotes, futures, and engine routes.

releases.name: Engine Companion 2026-09-17
releases.body: First release. The companion shows engine status and lets the owner pause, resume, or flatten from one page.

jobs.description: Phone friendly status and command page for a trading engine.

releases.name: Phasewell Scope 2026-09-22
releases.body: First release. The scope compares a song file with the microphone in several views. Seven updates the same day refined the controls.

jobs.description: Dual channel browser scope that compares a song file with the microphone.
